name: rq6-test-home
description:
RQ6, the final test on the home-advantage sets, run once and reported apart from the
main sets (decision 1): OpenPII 1M test (Czech and Slovak; only the own model trained on
OpenPII) and the held-out synthetic set (no model trained on it, but its templates are
the author's). Same systems and comparisons as rq6-test; no verdict is drawn here.
